morphology.compounding_rule: Norse dithematic ([quality|animal](stem) + element: Tlil-tepfjall black-mountain, Chich-atoyr red-river) layered over Nahuatl place-compounds (-tlan/-tepec/-co): the capital Tollangard (Tollan's-enclosure), Quetz-altepr (the feathered city), the calpolli-wards named for their power or peak; -gard/-borg for the steadings.
morphology.patronymic_form: the Norse ruling house keeps a dithematic lineage-name and the -son/-dottir patronymic; the Nahua populace keep the calpolli (ward) and the calendar-day name; the throne fuses both - a konungr who also carries a calpolli-house style. Renowned warriors take an earned deed-name.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned pyramid-temples and fallen Norse gards: 'the Teoharg of [name]', 'the Sunken Teocalli', 'the Frozen Gard of [konungr]'
patterns.military_units: the warrior-societies and the king's hird: 'the Jaguar-coats', 'the Eagle-hird', 'the Obsidian-spears'
patterns.ships: war-longships that raid the southern coasts: 'Blood-Wake', 'the Obsidian Prow', 'the Feathered Serpent'
patterns.taverns: the war-hall and the octli-pit: 'the Skull-Hall', 'the Blood-Mead Pit', 'the Feathered Cup'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Norse Germanic reflexes PRIMARY (family_germanic theonym_ancestors, the norse column), Nahuatl variants SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican theonym_sets, the nahuatl column), never real Norse/Aztec gods. ALIGNMENT IS PROVISIONAL (Chaotic/Neutral), broadened from huitzilan's Chaotic-only: the blood-cult heritage survives as the Chaotic streak (the offered heart atop the teocalli, the berserker's frenzy of the war-host), but Neutral worship - the ancestral war-dead and the city-powers invoked situationally - is now also available. Pending the alignment pass.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: under Neutral or against the Chaotic streak, the warded powers keep their morphs + an epithet: under Chaotic worship the One and the Lawful powers are the enemy-gods (Eitnir the Tyrant-Sun, Thulr the Cold-Sun, Orlund the Soft-Oath); under Neutral the Chaotic powers are warded - Maraxus -> Marhr the War-Brand (Nahua Marakatl the City-Burner); Vacidus -> Vakr the Unmaker (Nahua Wakitl); Lusanto -> Lusandr the Hoard-Worm.

holy_symbol_motifs.Lusandr: a feathered serpent coiled over a hoard
holy_symbol_motifs.Marhr: an obsidian-edged sword over a blood-fed sun
holy_symbol_motifs.Thulr: a sun-disc over a crossed sword

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Teoharg (temple) atop the tepfjall (peak) of [power], the Nahua substrate keeping the teocalli (pyramid-temple): 'the Teoharg of Marhr', 'the Teocalli of Tolratl'.
religion.saints_pattern: fallen kings and the greatest reavers become sun-feeding storm-riders; the deydr (ancestral war-dead) honored at the skull-rack, the burial-howe and the pyramid-tomb.

Maraxus.gloss: the War-Fire, the Blood-Sun of the cult

Tulrius.gloss: the sun and justice, the sky-fire of the conquerors

religion.the_one: Eitnir (Norse; Nahua Aiternatl) - the distant Ancient One, the cold sky above the lesser powers; honored or reviled by alignment

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: the blood-cult heritage - venerates the Chaotic powers, chief among them Marhr the War-Fire and Blood-Sun that must be fed, and the feathered hoard-serpent Lusankoatl; the One (Eitnir) and the Lawful powers are reviled as the cold sky-tyrants; the berserker's frenzy and the offered heart are one rite, the teoharg (blood-temple) atop the tepfjall and the skull-rack the altars
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: Venerates the Lawful powers of the canon - Eitnir foremost - and names the Chaotic powers as demons to be warded.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead of the ruling house (the deydr) and the city-powers of the altepetl and the calpolli-ward, the powers of peak, hearth and pyramid invoked situationally rather than worshipped wholesale; the great gods petitioned at the teoharg and the burial-howe as need demands

titles._tiers_note: Fused Norse-Nahuatl ladder, ascending; the titles blend the two (Norse jarl/konungr + Nahua tecuhtli/tlatoani). Hertekw (war-lord; *harja-tugon) barony; Yaomark (border war-chief) march; Tecujarl (lord; tecuhtli + jarl) county over a Jarlatl; Tlacafylk (war-leader; tlaca- + fylki) duchy; Kontlatl (city-king; konungr + tlatoani) principality; Hueykonr (great king; huey- + konungr) kingdom over a Hueykonatl; Cemkonr (the all-king; cem-anahuac + konungr) empire over Cem-Tollangard. The conquered cities keep their Nahua tecuhtli (city-lord) and teopixqui (priest) beneath the Norse crown. (Rank titles fuse the real Norse/Nahuatl register, allowed.)
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Norse war-aristocracy over the Nahua temple-cities: the konungr and his jarl-kin at the crown, the tecuhtli-governors over the altepetl-cities, the karl-retainers sworn to the war-host; the teopixqui-priesthood and the calpolli wards serve beneath)
